# Great Bear Rainforest South TSA 47 Instance

> Agent-facing index for the GBR South TSA 47 model. Read the linked pages before you change the project.

## Start here

- [Home](index.html): the documentation home, status, and model at a glance.
- [API reference](api/index.html): every public function, with its parameters, types, and return values.

## Guides

- [TSA 47 AOI](aoi.html): the current dissolved boundary, selection rule, and legal framework.
- [Public data and TSR](public-data.html): the data root, manifest, TSR fetch/extract evidence, and THLB derivation.
- [Model build](model-build.html): the FEMIC-to-ws4 chain, calibration, gates, and runtime boundary.
- [Model structure](model-structure.html): fragments, blocks, tracks, species mix, and accounts.
- [AAC benchmark](benchmark.html): targets, decade results, coverage run, and baseline distinction.
- [Web UI](web-ui.html): the serve command, geometry scale, checks, and security.
- [Reproduce](reproduce.html): a clean-checkout rebuild from public data.
- [Decisions and limitations](decisions.html): the recorded model decisions and caveats.
- [Glossary](glossary.html): AAC, AU, THLB, VRI, TSR, SI, and ws4 terms.

## API

- [build_aoi](api/build-aoi.html): the tracked boundary builder.
- [check_public_data](api/check-public-data.html): the public-data manifest check.
- [calibrate_thlb_proportion](api/calibrate-thlb-proportion.html): the THLB calibration.
- [build_baseline_schedule](api/build-baseline-schedule.html): the baseline schedule.
- [prepare_ws4_ui](api/prepare-ws4-ui.html): the UI geometry.
- [prepare_land_base](api/prepare-land-base.html): the land-base underlay.
- [check_runtime_signal](api/check-runtime-signal.html): the compiled-signal gate.
- [check_harvest_coverage](api/check-harvest-coverage.html): the managed-AU coverage gate.
- [check_workflow](api/check-workflow.html): the workflow validator.
- [dashboard](api/dashboard.html): the green dashboard.
